hints.title: First-Come Allocation
hints.text: Tickets are confirmed according to the order of booking time partitioned by flight.

hints.title: Window Ranking
hints.text: Use the ranking window function partitioned by flight_id and ordered by booking_time ascending.

hints.title: Comparison with Capacity
hints.text: Assign Confirmed if the passenger rank is within flight capacity; otherwise assign Waitlist.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
SELECT 
    p.passenger_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.flight_id ORDER BY p.booking_time ASC) <= f.capacity 
        THEN 'Confirmed' 
        ELSE 'Waitlist' 
    END AS status
FROM Passengers p
JOIN Flights f ON p.flight_id = f.flight_id
ORDER BY p.passenger_id ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Window ranking partitioned by flight and ordered chronologically by booking time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Correlated subqueries to determine passenger order scale quadratically with ticket count.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n log n) time due to window sorting and O(n) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply window functions with partition and order specifications for chronological ranking.
